cards.headline: Written for a film, not an album
cards.snippet: In 2017, American singer-songwriter Sufjan Stevens contributed to the official soundtrack of the drama film Call Me by Your Name. He supplied two original songs for it, "Mystery of Love" and "Visions of Gideon." So the song you're hearing belongs to a film soundtrack, not one of his studio albums. Both tracks reached the charts in France and the United States.

cards.headline: The sibling song got the Oscar nod
cards.snippet: Two original Sufjan Stevens songs appeared in the 2017 film Call Me by Your Name. One of them, "Mystery of Love," earned him an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Song. "Visions of Gideon," the song you're hearing, was its companion on the soundtrack. It reached the charts in France and the United States but was not the nominated one.
cards.context: Both songs were written for the same film.

cards.headline: The goodbye that opens the closing song
cards.snippet: It echoes "Mystery of Love," which begins with the "first time" of a touch or kiss and ends with "the last time that you touched me." This song carries that theme on, swapping in loved, touched and kissed.
cards.context: One commenter with 705 likes calls accepting this line "the hardest thing to do." Another says they start crying the moment it plays over the film's ending.

cards.headline: Life keeps going in the background
cards.snippet: The fact that life continues as normal in the background... oh my god. The sounds, the setting of the table for dinner, ugh... it’s so perfect. Because as hard as this shit can be, life does not stop.
cards.context: Notes how the ordinary household activity behind Elio makes the grief hit harder.

cards.headline: Voice and handpan duet, recorded as a live session
cards.snippet: Singer and handpan artist Josephine Pia Wild joins Malte Marten, who plays handpan, in a live session recorded in 2021. It was their first meeting. One listener: "I actually love this more than the original song! Your voice is truly amazing!"
